items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All five reported UX gaps addressed: header strip removed (MissionBody.tsx no longer mounts OperationCard/mc-op-stack), commands collapsed by default (MissionActivityFeedCommands.tsx), card.text/explanation render through MarkdownChunk, blocker card shows a derived one-line explanation with raw traceback collapsed behind Show details, and TDD authoring runs (test run immediately after writing the same test file) are excluded from the run-wide gate stamp.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Purely client-side reducer/render change; no new I/O or API boundaries. summarizeBlockerError() falls back to a generic sentence when the command output has no usable line, tested explicitly.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: card.explanation now renders through the same sanitized MarkdownChunk path already used for card.text/question.text (DO-NOT #4) — no dangerouslySetInnerHTML introduced; no user input reaches an unescaped sink.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: New/updated unit tests assert on rendered DOM outcome (toggle collapse/expand, markdown table element, blocker text derivation, gate-stamp exclusion) not internal state; each behavior change has both a happy-path and a boundary case (e.g. blocker fallback with no usable output line).

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: No new loops over unbounded data; command list rendering was already bounded by the existing feed coalescing.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: The bloat gate caught missionActivityFeed.ts (313 lines) and MissionActivityFeed.test.tsx (301 lines) crossing the 300-line convention. Fixed by real extraction, not line-merging: classifyToolBucket() moved to missionActivityFeedClassify.ts (already houses classification logic) and clearMultiTurnExplanations() moved to missionActivityFeedReconcile.ts (already does post-loop card cleanup); the test file's three new comments were condensed to one line each. missionActivityFeed.ts is now 294 lines, the test file 298.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: No serialized/on-disk format changed — ActivityCard is an in-memory reducer output only, never persisted or read back.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: scan_test_hygiene.py --diff reported no findings against the working-tree changes.
